newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end higher as investors return.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end higher as investors return.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed higher Sunday as retail investors returned to the market, seeing an opportunity for investment after a recent sharp fall in share prices, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index closed up 9.47 points, or 1.03 percent, at 1,883.86 on volume of 66.1 million taka. Of 86 traded issues, 65 gained and 27 lost.
"The market is consolidating after a long bearishness. Buyers are coming back," said one broker.
Leasing company IDLC gained 225 taka to 4,511, Singer Bangladesh rose 287 to 12,437, and Beximco Pharmaceuticals was up 6 to 190.
